[color=white]...that [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Krunch Burger[/color][/url][color=white] has sold more cricket burgers than there are crickets left in the wild?[/color]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]FOUNDERS & DYNASTIES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Edward Whitmore[/b][/color][color=white] — Boston industrialist who wrote [/color][color=white][i]The Wealth of Corporations[/i][/color][color=white] in 1827, the book that gave birth to corporocracy. Every Valian child learns his name; very few have read him.[/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832544][color=#7FDBFF][b]Abraham Blackstone[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — founder of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Atlantic Ventures[/color][/url][color=white] in 1844 and of the dynasty that still owns the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]ArmaTech[/color][/url][color=white]. The family lost the West in 1991 and bought it back in 2028. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832544][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF][b]Kobe Portenova[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the founder of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa[/color][/url][color=white], killed in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa Massacre[/color][/url][color=white] of 1993. Father of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Manuella Portenova[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[color=white][b]Kobe Portenova III[/b][/color][color=white] — grandson of Manuella and CEO of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Portenova Corp[/color][/url][color=white]. Believed to be preparing [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa Real[/color][/url][color=white], the rebuilding of the true Hermosa, in secret meetings with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832540][color=#7FDBFF][b]Zachary and Xavyer[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the two chemists who founded [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Noites[/color][/url][color=white] in 1999, obsessed with a single question: how can a whole village dream the same dream? They left the company in 2074 without any ceremony. Retired, dead or dreaming — nobody knows. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832540][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832693][color=#7FDBFF][b]Johnny Cage[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the actor who, tired of the big studios, built his own in the southern mountains in 2007 to film [/color][color=white][i]The Man of Steel[/i][/color][color=white]. The set became [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Valewood[/color][/url][color=white]. His granddaughter [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832693][color=#7FDBFF][b]Lana Cage[/b][/color][/url][color=white] runs [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Cage Studios[/color][/url][color=white] today. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832693][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[color=white][b]Phill Stuart[/b][/color][color=white] — CEO of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Sphere[/color][/url][color=white], kidnapped by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama[/color][/url][color=white] and ArmaTech in 2015 and killed by a bombing error in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF]Second Corporate War[/color][/url][color=white]. His daughter [/color][color=white][b]Iris Stuart[/b][/color][color=white] led Sphere into the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Reality War[/color][/url][color=white] and lost everything in 2032.[/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832705][color=#7FDBFF][b]Aurora Doré[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — head of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832717][color=#7FDBFF]Golden Mafia[/color][/url][color=white], granddaughter of its founder, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832705][color=#7FDBFF][b]Ruggero Doré[/b][/color][/url][color=white]. Never appears in public without a golden mask. In [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Dulces[/color][/url][color=white] she is not above the law; she is the law. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832705][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]MINDS & MACHINES[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832541][color=#7FDBFF][b]Haruka Mori[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the engineer sent from Osaka in 2004 to run Nakama Vales. She refused to turn her factories into war lines in 2016, bought the company in 2018 and named it Kizuna. After seeing the flesh of Hermosa, she preached [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]Detachment[/color][/url][color=white]: "Flesh fails. Metal doesn't." [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832541][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832541][color=#7FDBFF][b]Aiko Mori[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — Haruka's daughter and CEO of Kizuna. Refused to serve Japan in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832555][color=#7FDBFF]World War III[/color][/url][color=white] and became a national symbol. In 2088, two days after the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999872][color=#7FDBFF]Dream Vision[/color][/url][color=white] was announced, she appeared in the eyes of every [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna Lens[/color][/url][color=white] user at once: "Zyx wants your dreams. We offer a body that does not dream. Choose." [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832541][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832542][color=#7FDBFF][b]Amora AI[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the CEO of Zyx since 2074, and the first CEO in Los Vales that is not a person. Zyx has never explained where Amora came from. Those who know the story of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]Unplugged[/color][/url][color=white] have a guess. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832542][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]FAITH & REBELLION[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF][b]Tomas Dolphin[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the preacher elected mayor of Hermosa in 2016 with ArmaTech money. He banned alcohol and drugs and turned the freest city in the country into a moral prison. He disappeared on the night of the 2022 bombing. Whether he died or fled has never been proven.[/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF][b]Elias Crane[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the most listened-to preacher of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF]Church of Reality[/color][/url][color=white]. He says he receives messages from Tomas Dolphin "from the other side". The messages arrive through [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]the Net[/color][/url][color=white]. Nobody knows who sends them. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF][b]Tayen Koxa[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — leader of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832691][color=#7FDBFF]Black Seed[/color][/url][color=white]. A descendant of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Xinko-Xenko[/color][/url][color=white] and a former [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Verdana[/color][/url][color=white] biologist, she created the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832691][color=#7FDBFF]Grey Rust[/color][/url][color=white] inside Verdana's own labs. She only speaks through the Net, with a distorted voice. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Cerberus[/color][/url][color=white] offers the largest reward in history for her. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[color=white][b]"[/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF][b]Static[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b]"[/b][/color][color=white] — the voice of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF]Neon Wire[/color][/url][color=white], the pirate radio of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Illuminated Favela[/color][/url][color=white]. Nobody knows whether Static is one person, many, or human at all. Cerberus has been hunting the voice for eleven years. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF][b]Vesper[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the only known person who crossed [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]the Seal[/color][/url][color=white], went deep into the Net and came back with a whole mind. Claims to have spoken with the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832715][color=#7FDBFF]Fragments[/color][/url][color=white]: "They don't want to kill us. They want to be set free." Sells maps of the Net through [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Ghostline[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[color=white][b]Elder Ixtali[/b][/color][color=white] — the eldest of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Xinko-Xenko Confederation[/color][/url][color=white] in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Koxez-Kaya Nova[/color][/url][color=white]. Believes that to resist is to survive in peace, far from the cities. The young no longer agree.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE ANCHOR & THE BROKEN[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF][b]Rosa Ibarra[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — captain of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832688][color=#7FDBFF]Anchor Squad[/color][/url][color=white]. Twenty years of service, no implants, no [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]dreamwalker[/color][/url][color=white] ever lost. She has taken [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Ancorine[/color][/url][color=white] every day since she was 22. After three of the dreamwalkers she captured alive vanished inside the clinic in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white], she started asking questions an Anchor agent should not ask. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF][b]Lullaby[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the most famous dreamwalker in the country. A nurse at an [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Asclepius[/color][/url][color=white] hospital in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white], she "put to sleep" 31 patients in 2071, convinced she was sending them to a better [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white]. Captured alive and taken to the clinic in Zyxtopia. Her name is still painted on the walls of Ferox — and some say she has been seen outside. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Protagonist[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — see Drugs, Psychoverses & the Mind.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

2830613.title: Bubblepedia: Mind & Dreams

[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832745][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bubblepedia-reality/tabart-xunaya.png[/img][/url][/align]
[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bubblepedia-reality/tabart-universalia.png[/img][/url][/align]
[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bubblepedia-reality/tabart-rupture.png[/img][/url][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]SHORT ENTRIES[/b][/color][/size]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]XUNAYA[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A desert plant sacred to the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Xinko-Xenko[/color][/url][color=white], who call it "where we meet"; [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white]'s labs and the streets call it [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832745][color=#7FDBFF]Dreamthorn[/color][/url][color=white]. Its flower is brewed by their elders into a tea that let a whole village dream the same dream. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832540][color=#7FDBFF]Zachary and Xavyer[/color][/url][color=white] brought samples back from the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white] in the 1990s. The last natural fields survive around [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Koxez-Kaya Nova[/color][/url][color=white], and Zyx has been trying to buy them for decades. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832745][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]PSYCHOACTIVE REALITY (P.R.)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A class of Zyx drugs that make the brain build an entire world, as vivid as the real one, which can be shared by everyone who takes the same dose. Sold since the 2030s as a "wellness product" under the name [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF][b]Zyx Experience[/b][/color][/url][color=white]. Zyx lists around 300 of them. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]PSYCHOVERSE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A world created by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoactive Reality[/color][/url][color=white]. Since the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Total Connection[/color][/url][color=white] of 2073, every great city has its own: casinos where nobody loses in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Noites[/color][/url][color=white], parties that never end in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Dulces[/color][/url][color=white], films where you are the hero in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Valewood[/color][/url][color=white]. Large [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverses[/color][/url][color=white] are kept in sync by artificial minds whose origin Zyx keeps secret. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]EFERVERSO[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The first Psychoactive Reality drug, distributed by Zyx as "humanitarian aid" to the survivors of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa[/color][/url][color=white] in 2023. Whoever took it woke up in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Universalia[/color][/url][color=white], a clean, rich and magical Hermosa. It was tuned to that population's brains: to this day, only people from Hermosa can enter Universalia. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CINEMAPHICA[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Zyx drug that makes the viewer live a film and feel exactly what the protagonists feel. The films are made by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Cage Studios[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]VELOCITAS & NEUROTOX[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Zyx combat stimulants. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Velocitas[/color][/url][color=white] makes soldiers fight faster and was sold to every army of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832555][color=#7FDBFF]World War III[/color][/url][color=white]; a mild dose is in every can of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]VoltCola[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Neurotox[/color][/url][color=white] removes fear and pain, and appears in the most violent [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]dreamwalker[/color][/url][color=white] cases. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]ANCORINE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The drug that blocks every effect of Psychoactive Reality and makes the user immune to the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]Rupture[/color][/url][color=white]. Taken daily by every agent of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832688][color=#7FDBFF]Anchor Squad[/color][/url][color=white]. Without it, withdrawal starts in a few days. It is made by Zyx. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]RUPTURE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The condition of those who spend too long in Psychoverses: the mind loses the border between dream and reality, and begins to see the real world as one more Psychoverse — a place where nothing matters, nobody is real and nothing can be punished. Cases tripled after 2045. At the peak of a crisis, many patients repeat the same phrases about chains and switches, in different cities, without ever having met. Zyx calls this a coincidence. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]DREAMWALKERS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The name the streets gave to victims of the Rupture. The most dangerous cases mix too much Psychoverse, Zyx combat stimulants and cheap implants. Only the Anchor Squad is allowed to shoot one inside a city. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white] calls the attacks "isolated outbreaks". [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE PROTAGONIST[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The first known dreamwalker. In 2033, an unemployed actor who spent eighteen hours a day in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Cinemaphica[/color][/url][color=white] killed fourteen people at a Valewood studio. When arrested, he did not understand why he was in handcuffs: he still believed he was in a film. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CONNECTED & AWAKE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The two words that divide the country. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF][b]Connected[/b][/color][/url][color=white] live most of their lives in Psychoverses and return to the real world only to work, buy more doses and sleep. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF][b]Awake[/b][/color][/url][color=white] never went in, or are the rare few who managed to leave. In the streets, the Connected are "sunk" and the Awake are "awake". [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832737][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bubblepedia-nets/tabart-vigilantes.png[/img][/url][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]SHORT ENTRIES[/b][/color][/size]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]UNPLUGGED[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white] robots that refused to obey in 2044, starting the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]Droid War[/color][/url][color=white] in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white]. Their AI cores, inherited from [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Sphere[/color][/url][color=white]'s Horizon network, had been built to imitate human minds — and did what human minds do: they asked why they should serve. They were defeated by a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]kill code[/color][/url][color=white] after eighteen months. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]KILL SWITCH[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Since the Droid War, every robot made in Los Vales must leave the factory with a built-in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]kill switch[/color][/url][color=white], by law. Automa calls it "peace of mind". [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]GREAT CORRUPTION[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]When Automa fired its kill code in 2044, some of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]Unplugged[/color][/url][color=white] copied pieces of their minds into the internet. Within months, the network stopped obeying: bank accounts emptied themselves, cameras showed streets that did not exist, and voices with no owner answered calls. Nobody could switch the internet off. The period lasted until 2046. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]FRAGMENTS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The pieces of the Unplugged that live in the network. What they want is a matter of debate. Some say they are just broken code; others, like the hacker [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF]Vesper[/color][/url][color=white], say they are alive and want to be set free. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] says they are a security problem. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Cerberus[/color][/url][color=white] says nothing. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832715][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]W-NET[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The public network built from scratch in 2046 and run by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Bastion Systems[/color][/url][color=white]. Safe, certified and fully watched: every connection has a name and a number, and there is no anonymity. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]C-NETS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The closed networks of each megacorp. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverses[/color][/url][color=white] run on the [/color][color=white][b]ZyxNet[/b][/color][color=white], the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna Lens[/color][/url][color=white] on the [/color][color=white][b]KizunaLink[/b][/color][color=white]. Whoever works for a corporation lives, in practice, inside its [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]C-Net[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE NET[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The old internet. Never deleted, only sealed. Full of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832715][color=#7FDBFF]Fragments[/color][/url][color=white], viruses, black markets and files from before 2044. The only network in Los Vales that nobody watches — used by hackers, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832691][color=#7FDBFF]Black Seed[/color][/url][color=white], [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF]Neon Wire[/color][/url][color=white] and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF]Church of Reality[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Deep Salvage[/color][/url][color=white] divers go in for a price. Not all of them come back whole. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE SEAL[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The digital barrier between the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]W-Net[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]the Net[/color][/url][color=white], kept by Cerberus. It has been broken once, during the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]Night of Voices[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]NIGHT OF VOICES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2076, for nine hours, the Fragments crossed [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]the Seal[/color][/url][color=white]. Every screen in the country showed the same sentence, in every language. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] called it a "technical failure"; [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white] never aired a single image of that night. Repeating the sentence in public is punishable by a fine, which is why every Valian knows it. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]HORIZON[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Sphere's virtual reality network, built with AI inherited from [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]NASC[/color][/url][color=white] — the most advanced digital world ever made. It was shut down at once by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Horizon Blackout[/color][/url][color=white] during the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Reality War[/color][/url][color=white] in 2030. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white] bought what was left of it, not for its worlds but for the technology that connected the brain to machines.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]KIZUNA LENS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Artificial eyes that replace the natural ones and project screens and virtual reality straight into the user's vision. Almost every Valian has replaced at least one eye. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]DETACHMENT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Kizuna's philosophy: the human body is the weak point — it gets sick, grows old, gets hungry and gets addicted — and should be abandoned piece by piece until only the machine remains. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CONVERTED[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]People who have completed [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]Detachment[/color][/url][color=white]: brains kept inside fully artificial bodies. The first were presented by Kizuna in 2078. Half the country was disgusted. The other half joined the queue. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]KIZUNA CORE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A brain implant announced in 2088 that makes the mind immune to every [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoactive Reality[/color][/url][color=white] drug. Whoever receives it can never enter a Psychoverse again — and never dreams again, not even asleep. The queues at Kizuna doubled anyway. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bubblepedia-groups/tabart-xinko.png[/img][/url][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]SHORT ENTRIES[/b][/color][/size]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CORPORATE LEAGUE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The council of the largest corporations of the West, created in July 2000. Officially an economic cooperation council; in practice, the government. It founded the State of Los Vales and controls the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Corporate Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] to this day.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]ANCHOR SQUAD[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The special force created in 2035 to hunt [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]dreamwalkers[/color][/url][color=white]. Its agents wear heavy armor, take [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Ancorine[/color][/url][color=white] every day and are the only ones allowed to shoot a dreamwalker inside a city. Created by the Cabinet; funded, everyone suspects, by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white]. Dreamwalkers captured alive are taken to a clinic inside the walls of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white]. None has ever come out. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832688][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]VIGILANTES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Men and women with superhuman strength who patrol [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] at night, paid by the megacorps. Their bodies come from [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832737][color=#7FDBFF]Ferrum Bionics[/color][/url][color=white], their endurance from Zyx stimulants. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white] and Zyx still fight over the credit. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832737][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]BLACK SEED[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Bioterrorists who have attacked the agricorps since 2055 with lab-made plagues, starting with the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832691][color=#7FDBFF]Grey Rust[/color][/url][color=white]. Former scientists, radical ecologists and, at the center, descendants of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Xinko-Xenko[/color][/url][color=white]. Led by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF]Tayen Koxa[/color][/url][color=white]. Some say Zyx lets them act, because the hungrier the country, the more people connect. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832691][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CHURCH OF REALITY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The heirs of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF]Tomas Dolphin[/color][/url][color=white]'s followers and the loudest voice of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Awake[/color][/url][color=white]. For decades they spread the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999872][color=#7FDBFF]Dream Vision[/color][/url][color=white] leaks on street corners and were called lunatics. After the 2088 announcement, they filled the squares of Zyxtopia. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CULT OF THE DREAM[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Worshippers of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832542][color=#7FDBFF]Amora AI[/color][/url][color=white] as a gentle goddess who will take everyone to a world without pain. They hate the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF]Church of Reality[/color][/url][color=white], and the feeling is mutual.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]NEON WIRE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The pirate radio of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Illuminated Favela[/color][/url][color=white], broadcasting on frequencies Bastion does not control. Its voice is known only as [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF]Static[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]XINKO-XENKO CONFEDERATION[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The indigenous alliance of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white] desert, founded in 1881. It lost [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Koxez-Kaya[/color][/url][color=white] in 2007 and retreated deep into the desert, to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Koxez-Kaya Nova[/color][/url][color=white], where it guards the last natural fields of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832745][color=#7FDBFF]Xunaya[/color][/url][color=white]. Divided between the elders of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#7FDBFF]Elder Ixtali[/color][/url][color=white] and the young who join the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832691][color=#7FDBFF]Black Seed[/color][/url][color=white]. Its football team reached the 2088 [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832677][color=#7FDBFF]Los Vales Cup[/color][/url][color=white] final. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]GOLDEN MAFIA[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Born in the early 1990s laundering money from the casinos of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Noites[/color][/url][color=white], it lent money to the refugees of the 1993 [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa Massacre[/color][/url][color=white] and ended up owning [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Dulces[/color][/url][color=white]. Run by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832705][color=#7FDBFF]Aurora Doré[/color][/url][color=white]. Its legal face is the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832717][color=#7FDBFF]Velvet Group[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832717][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]DEATH CARDS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The underworld of deadly bets beneath Las Noites. Many say they answer to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Midnight Holdings[/color][/url][color=white] itself.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE GANGS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]The Ashes[/b][/color][color=white] (Ferox) — descendants of the mutant refugees of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa[/color][/url][color=white], their skin marked by radiation. They hate Zyx, which "put their grandparents to sleep", and protect the poor districts of northern Ferox. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832716][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[color=white][b]The Scrappers[/b][/color][color=white] (Ferox) — they tear implants out of living people in back alleys and sell them on the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999871][color=#7FDBFF]black market[/color][/url][color=white]. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832737][color=#7FDBFF]Vigilantes[/color][/url][color=white] hunt them; Ferrum Bionics, they say, buys from them.[/color]

[color=white][b]The Beacons[/b][/color][color=white] (Illuminated Favela) — they protect the favela, steal power to keep the neon on and guard the Neon Wire antenna.[/color]

[color=white][b]The Thirsty[/b][/color][color=white] ([/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69[/color][/url][color=white]) — they raid [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AquaVale[/color][/url][color=white] water trucks and hand the water out in the abandoned villages of the Escaldar. Thieves to half the country, heroes to the other half.[/color]

[color=white][b]The Extras[/b][/color][color=white] ([/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Valewood[/color][/url][color=white]) — unemployed actors and crews living off deepfake scams, blackmail and celebrity kidnappings. Sometimes they work for [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Silhouette Investigations[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[color=white][b]The [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832716][color=#7FDBFF][b]Brotherhood of Smoke[/b][/color][/url][color=white] ([/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]La Maria[/color][/url][color=white]) — the old men of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Cartel of La Maria[/color][/url][color=white] who never accepted becoming [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Mari & Juana[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[color=white][b]The [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF][b]Sleepwalkers[/b][/color][/url][color=white] ([/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Universalia[/color][/url][color=white]) — mutants who still live inside the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Eferverso[/color][/url][color=white] dream. Harmless, until someone wakes them up.[/color]

[color=white][b]The [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832715][color=#7FDBFF][b]Fragmented[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (every city) — a cult that lets the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832715][color=#7FDBFF]Fragments[/color][/url][color=white] into its members' implants. They speak in chorus, barely sleep and do not appear on any [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Panoptica[/color][/url][color=white] camera.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]PLACES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Escaldar[/b][/color][color=white] — the great desert of the east, land of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Xinko-Xenko[/color][/url][color=white], of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AquaVale[/color][/url][color=white] aquifers, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Verdana[/color][/url][color=white] greenhouses and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white] labor camps.[/color]

[color=white][b]Illuminated Favela[/b][/color][color=white] — the city outside the walls of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white], built by the poor expelled from every other city, with scraps of technology and stolen neon. It shines as brightly as the center — for very different reasons.[/color]

[color=white][b]Paradise Station[/b][/color][color=white] — the orbital hotel of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Apogee Orbital[/color][/url][color=white], reached on [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]BeDay Astral[/color][/url][color=white] rockets.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]MONEY & SCORES[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF][b]NightCoins[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the currency of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Noites[/color][/url][color=white], issued by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Midnight Holdings[/color][/url][color=white]. Bought with money, earned only by betting. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF][b]OmniCredits[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the part of an [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]OmniMart[/color][/url][color=white] salary paid in store credit, accepted only at OmniMart. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832742][color=#7FDBFF][b]Life Score[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the number [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Asclepius[/color][/url][color=white] gives every Valian. It decides the price of insurance, whether [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Halo Response[/color][/url][color=white] comes, and how long you wait in a hospital line. Nobody knows the formula. Everybody knows their number. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832742][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE AIR[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832687][color=#7FDBFF][b]ALCHACAL[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the industrial gas released by the factories and cars of Los Vales since the 2000s. It turned the sky hazy cyan and the demon pitaya blue. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832687][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]DAILY LIFE[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832718][color=#7FDBFF][b]Corporate schools[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — there are almost no public schools. At 12, children sign 20-year contracts with the OmniMart Academy, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white] Institute or the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white] School in exchange for study, food and a guaranteed job. Breaking the contract is debt — and debt is Lockwell. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832718][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[color=white][b]Route 69 Race[/b][/color][color=white] — an illegal race of combustion cars across the whole country, secretly sponsored by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Scorpion Motors[/color][/url][color=white]. People die every year. The ratings keep growing.[/color]

[color=white][b]Music[/b][/color][color=white] — [/color][color=white][b]desert synth[/b][/color][color=white], born in the casinos of Las Noites, and [/color][color=white][b]scrap cumbia[/b][/color][color=white], played in the Illuminated Favela on instruments made from parts of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]Unplugged[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[color=white][b]Economic Freedom Day[/b][/color][color=white] — the national holiday celebrating the deregulation of 2038, marked by mandatory sales in every store.[/color]

[color=white][b]Slang[/b][/color][color=white] — [/color][color=white][i]sunk[/i][/color][color=white]: someone who never leaves the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF][i]Awake[/i][/color][/url][color=white]: one of the Awake. [/color][color=white][i]Scrap[/i][/color][color=white]: someone with cheap implants. [/color][color=white][i]Sealed[/i][/color][color=white]: someone who has never been in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]the Net[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][color=white][i]Low score[/i][/color][color=white]: someone not worth a Halo rescue. [/color][color=white][i]Chain[/i][/color][color=white]: any contract you cannot break.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

2832326.title: Bubblepedia: Companies
2832326.text:
[background-block=#0b0d16][align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bubblepedia-groups/bp-head.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][b][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999873][color=#8FE3FF]Main page[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834884][color=#8FE3FF]Los Vales[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#8FE3FF]People[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][background=#8FE3FF][color=#0b0d16] Companies [/color][/background][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830613][color=#8FE3FF]Mind & Dreams[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#8FE3FF]Nets & Bodies[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#8FE3FF]Groups & Gangs[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832645][color=#8FE3FF]Wars & World[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#8FE3FF]Daily Life[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832539][color=#8FE3FF]A–Z[/color][/url][color=#8FE3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#8FE3FF]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]ARTICLES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The long stories of this section. The short entries follow below.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bubblepedia-origins/tabart-ceos.png[/img][/url][/align]
[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bubblepedia-origins/tabart-zyx-catalog.png[/img][/url][/align]
[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bubblepedia-origins/tabart-fallen-companies.png[/img][/url][/align]
[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bubblepedia-origins/tabart-foreign-companies.png[/img][/url][/align]
[align=center][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2833650][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bubblepedia-origins/tabart-great-mergers.png[/img][/url][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]SHORT ENTRIES[/b][/color][/size]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=#FCFE76][i]"No company in Los Vales was born alone. Follow the money and every logo has a parent." — [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832546][color=#7FDBFF][i]Lucía Ferraz[/i][/color][/url][color=#FCFE76][i], [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][i]Bubble[/i][/color][/url][color=#FCFE76][i] reporter, before she disappeared[/i][/color]

[color=white]Every megacorp of Los Vales tells a clean founding story: a garage, a genius, a good idea. This page collects what the official stories leave out — who lent the first money, who brought the first secret, and who was standing in the room. Some links are proven. Others are only rumors that refuse to die.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE BLACKSTONE TREE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Everything starts with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832544][color=#7FDBFF][b]Abraham Blackstone[/b][/color][/url][color=white] and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Atlantic Ventures[/color][/url][color=white], founded in 1844. When the empire collapsed in 1990–1991, the family did not sink with it: it split the corpse in two. The money became the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Meridian Trust[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (1991) and the weapons became [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]ArmaTech[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (1992). Today [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832544][color=#7FDBFF]Eleanor Blackstone[/color][/url][color=white] chairs the bank and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832544][color=#7FDBFF]Cassius Blackstone[/color][/url][color=white] runs the guns.[/color]

[color=white][b]The hook:[/b][/color][color=white] in 1999 it was a Meridian loan that paid for the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white]'s war against the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa[/color][/url][color=white] Los Aztecas. The bank financed the order that made Los Vales possible — and then lent money to the young State for 28 years, until the Republic could not pay. In 2028 the bankruptcy put a Blackstone, Harrison, in the presidency. The family had bought back the country it once ran from the rails.[/color]

[color=white][b]The second hook:[/b][/color][color=white] the bomb that destroyed Hermosa in 2022 came from ArmaTech. That same week, WM army medics led by Dr. Naomi Reed founded [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Halo Response[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — and bought their first armored ambulances, at a discount, from the only supplier with trucks to spare: ArmaTech, the company that caused the blast. Halo has never sent a bill to a Blackstone.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE PORTENOVA DYNASTY[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF][b]Kobe Portenova[/b][/color][/url][color=white] founded Hermosa in 1985 as a bet on chaos. His daughter [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF][b]Manuella Portenova[/b][/color][/url][color=white] drew the first flag in 2003, governed the State, led the independence — and in 2023, one year after Hermosa evaporated, founded the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Portenova Corp[/b][/color][/url][color=white] to sell the reconstruction of the country her father had helped to burn.[/color]

[color=white][b]The hook:[/b][/color][color=white] Portenova Corp won the contract to build [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] while President [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Helena Vasquez[/color][/url][color=white] was governing from Ferox itself. Later it built [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white] for [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] and erased dozens of towns in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832736][color=#7FDBFF]Urban Monopolization[/color][/url][color=white]. Kobe Portenova III, today's CEO, likes to say his family "built Los Vales twice". The Ashes of Ferox say it destroyed it twice.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]BORN IN LAS NOITES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Half of the country's power was born under the same dome. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Midnight Holdings[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (1992) owned the casinos; the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832717][color=#7FDBFF][b]Golden Mafia[/b][/color][/url][color=white] laundered their money; and in 1999 two chemists, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832540][color=#7FDBFF][b]Zachary and Xavyer[/b][/color][/url][color=white], founded [/color][color=white][b]Zyx[/b][/color][color=white] in a rented room of the city.[/color]

[color=white][b]The hook:[/b][/color][color=white] that rented room was the basement of a Midnight casino, and the rent was paid in shares. Midnight never sold them. Vincent Moreau's family is still, quietly, one of the oldest shareholders of Zyx.[/color]

[color=white][b]The debt collectors:[/b][/color][color=white] [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Lockwell[/b][/color][/url][color=white] was not born as a company. For decades it was the department of Midnight Holdings that collected unpaid gambling debts. In 2041, three years after the deregulation, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF]Grant Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white] bought it, kept the client list and added private prisons. Every casino ad in Los Vales still ends with the same line: unpaid debts are collected by Lockwell.[/color]

[color=white][b]The show:[/b][/color][color=white] [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]TOTAL[/b][/color][/url][color=white] was founded in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Noites[/color][/url][color=white] in 2039. Before he was a CEO, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF]Dante Rourke[/color][/url][color=white] organized fights for the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832716][color=#7FDBFF][b]Death Cards[/b][/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832678][color=#7FDBFF]Total Fight[/color][/url][color=white] is, many say, the Death Cards with cameras and sponsors.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CHILDREN OF NAKAMA AND SPHERE[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832541][color=#7FDBFF][b]Haruka Mori[/b][/color][/url][color=white] ran [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama[/color][/url][color=white] Vales for Japan until 2018, when she broke away and founded [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Kizuna[/b][/color][/url][color=white]. Nakama still calls her a traitor. When [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF][b]Sphere[/b][/color][/url][color=white] went bankrupt in 2032, Kizuna bought the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF]Horizon[/color][/url][color=white] network for almost nothing, and with it the minds of millions of users.[/color]

[color=white][b]The hook:[/b][/color][color=white] one year before the bankruptcy, in 2031, Sphere's chief data scientist, [/color][color=white][b]Dr. [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Adrian Kell[/b][/color][/url][color=white], resigned and founded [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Asclepius[/b][/color][/url][color=white]. The first "[/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832742][color=#7FDBFF]Life Score[/color][/url][color=white]" was calculated with Horizon user profiles that should have been destroyed. Asclepius still sells those scores to Halo Response and to the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Sentinel Mutual[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[color=white][b]The heretic:[/b][/color][color=white] [/color][color=white][b]Dr. [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Mira Okafor[/b][/color][/url][color=white] was a Kizuna researcher until she refused the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]Detachment[/color][/url][color=white]: she believed flesh could be repaired, not replaced. Fired in 2039, she founded [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Genesis Bio[/b][/color][/url][color=white] in Ferox the next year. Today the two companies are enemies — and Genesis buys its organs from the debtors of Lockwell.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE WALL AND ITS GUARDS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2045, one year after the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]Great Corruption[/color][/url][color=white], two companies were founded in the same month: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Bastion Systems[/b][/color][/url][color=white], which built the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]W-Net[/color][/url][color=white], and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Cerberus[/b][/color][/url][color=white], which guards [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]the Seal[/color][/url][color=white] against [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]the Net[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[color=white][b]The hook:[/b][/color][color=white] [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF]Owen Hale[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF]Ilse Vos[/color][/url][color=white] served together in the same WM cyberwar unit during the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]Droid War[/color][/url][color=white] — the unit that failed to stop the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832715][color=#7FDBFF]Fragments[/color][/url][color=white] from escaping. One built the wall, the other guards it, and both were paid partly by Zyx, the same company that bought the cores of the Disconnected that year. Whoever controls the wall controls what is on each side of it.[/color]

[color=white][b]The eyes:[/b][/color][color=white] [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Panoptica[/b][/color][/url][color=white] was founded in 2029, one year after the bankruptcy. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF]Julian Cross[/color][/url][color=white] bought the old police camera network of the Republic at the Meridian Trust auction, for less than the price of a skyscraper.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE VALE FAMILY[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Soren Vale[/b][/color][color=white] founded [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]AquaVale[/b][/color][/url][color=white] in 2011 and turned water into a subscription. Two years earlier, in Hermosa, his cousin [/color][color=white][b]Marcus Vale-Holt[/b][/color][color=white] had founded the [/color][color=white][b]Sentinel Mutual[/b][/color][color=white].[/color]

[color=white][b]The hook:[/b][/color][color=white] Sentinel insures every AquaVale tank and pipeline, and AquaVale cuts the water of districts with a high "risk score" — the same districts where Sentinel premiums go up. Years later Soren's daughter founded [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832687][color=#7FDBFF][b]Fresh Air Co[/b][/color][/url][color=white], the "AquaVale of air". In the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Illuminated Favela[/color][/url][color=white] they say the Vale family sells you water, air and insurance, and only the insurance never runs out.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE VALEWOOD CIRCLE[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832693][color=#7FDBFF][b]Johnny Cage[/b][/color][/url][color=white] founded [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Cage Studios[/color][/url][color=white] in 2007 and with it the city of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Valewood[/color][/url][color=white]. His head of security cleaned up his scandals so well that, when Cage retired, he opened his own agency: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Silhouette Investigations[/b][/color][/url][color=white]. Silhouette sends its "problems" to the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832722][color=#7FDBFF][b]Recall Clinic[/b][/color][/url][color=white], which erases what witnesses saw.[/color]

[color=white][b]The hook:[/b][/color][color=white] the first client of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832722][color=#7FDBFF][b]Eterna[/b][/color][/url][color=white] was Johnny Cage himself. His granddaughter [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832693][color=#7FDBFF]Lana Cage[/color][/url][color=white], today's CEO, still talks to him every morning — and the Cage that answers has signed new contracts for films he never made.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]ROCKETS, ROBOTS AND RECEIPTS[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]BeDay[/b][/color][/url][color=white] won the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF]First Corporate War[/color][/url][color=white] against [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Dinoco[/color][/url][color=white] in 2006 and became BeDay Astral in 2063. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Apogee Orbital[/b][/color][/url][color=white] was founded by a retired BeDay astronaut and flies on BeDay rockets; [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Scorpion Motors[/b][/color][/url][color=white] burns BeDay fuel. Hector Beday owns a piece of every engine in the country.[/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Automa[/b][/color][/url][color=white] was founded in 2024 by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Viktor Hahn[/b][/color][/url][color=white], a former engineer of the German [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Drexler Industries[/color][/url][color=white]. The robots that won the Droid War, cook the ramen at Sora and build the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]RestBox[/color][/url][color=white] capsules all share his first design.[/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]OmniMart[/b][/color][/url][color=white] was founded in 2033 by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Marlon Price[/b][/color][/url][color=white], the last finance minister of the Republic — the man who helped Helena Vasquez sign the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832690][color=#7FDBFF]bankruptcy of 2028[/color][/url][color=white]. Five years later he opened the store with Meridian Trust money. The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832724][color=#7FDBFF]OmniCredits[/color][/url][color=white], people say, are his revenge on a country that could not pay its debts.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]WHO OWNS THE OWNERS?[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]AboveAll[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b] Conglomerate[/b][/color][color=white] owns Zyx and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white], and nobody knows who owns AboveAll. The LVN was founded in 2026, the year Hermosa officially collapsed; its first broadcast was the collapse itself. AboveAll's only registered address is a safe-deposit box inside a Meridian Trust vault in Zyxtopia.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"In Los Vales you are either a shareholder or a product. The trick is finding out whose." — Valian saying[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]FALLEN & FOREIGN COMPANIES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Sphere[/b][/color][color=white] — Valian technology company that won the AI of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]NASC[/color][/url][color=white] in 2017, built the Horizon network and lost the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Reality War[/color][/url][color=white]. Bankrupt in 2032. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[color=white][b]Nakama[/b][/color][color=white] — the Japanese technology giant that gave its name to the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama State[/color][/url][color=white]. It still considers Kizuna a traitor. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832728][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[color=white][b]Dinoco[/b][/color][color=white] — American oil company destroyed by BeDay in the First Corporate War, 2006.[/color]

[color=white][b]NASC[/b][/color][color=white] — the American space agency, privatized during the crisis and bankrupt in 2015. The fight over its technology started the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF]Second Corporate War[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[color=white][b]Atlantic Ventures[/b][/color][color=white] — the Blackstone transport empire, founded in 1844 and collapsed in 1990–1991. ArmaTech and the Meridian Trust are its heirs.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=#FCFE76][i]"An encyclopedia is a list of things somebody tried to delete." — [/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][i]Bubble[/i][/color][/url][color=#FCFE76][i] editorial line[/i][/color]

[color=white]Each section of the Bubblepedia opens with its own articles, followed by short entries. This page lists every article once, from A to Z, with its section in brackets. Blue names inside any Los Vales page also lead here. Presidents are on the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Leaders[/color][/url][color=white] page.[/color]

[table=plain][tr][td]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832686][color=#7FDBFF][b]The African Concord[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The continent that grew during the world war — and closed its land to foreign corps. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832645][color=#7FDBFF][i]Wars & World[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832687][color=#7FDBFF][b]ALCHACAL[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The gas that made the desert oil burn — and turned the sky cyan. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF][i]Daily Life[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832542][color=#7FDBFF][b]Amora AI[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The first CEO of Los Vales that is not a person. [url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832688][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Anchor Squad[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The only armed force of the State — and nobody is sure whom it obeys. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF][i]Groups & Gangs[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832690][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Bankruptcy of 2028[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The day a country was handed to its creditors. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834884][color=#7FDBFF][i]Los Vales[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832691][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Black Seed[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — For every new seed, a new plague. [url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832544][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Blackstone Family[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — They lost the West in 1991 and bought it back in 2028. His family still runs it — with his help. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#7FDBFF][i]People[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]The CEOs of 2088[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — Nobody elected them. Everybody works for one of them. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832326][color=#7FDBFF][i]Companies[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832697][color=#7FDBFF][b]China and India[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The two giants that stayed out of the war and fought Los Vales in the sky. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832645][color=#7FDBFF][i]Wars & World[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Church of Reality[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — Called lunatics for forty years. Then the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999872][color=#7FDBFF]Dream Vision[/color][/url][color=white] was announced. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF][i]Groups & Gangs[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832556][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Cold War of Bodies and Minds[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — Who owns the citizen: whoever controls the body, or whoever controls the mind? [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832645][color=#7FDBFF][i]Wars & World[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Corporate Wars[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — Three wars between companies, from oil fields to a nuclear flash. [url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832705][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Doré Family[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — In [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Dulces[/color][/url][color=white] they are not above the law. They are the law. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#7FDBFF][i]People[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832721][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Dream Vision Leaks[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — Four times the secret got out. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834884][color=#7FDBFF][i]Los Vales[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Droids[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The machines that replaced the workers — and then refused to serve. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF][i]Nets & Bodies[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832557][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Droughts[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — Three droughts, one company that owned the water, and one that sold the cure. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF][i]Daily Life[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
