[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832708][color=#7FDBFF][b]The European Federation[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — Old, rich, regulated — and the only bloc that ever told [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] no. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832645][color=#7FDBFF][i]Wars & World[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]F[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF][b]Faces of the Street[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The people who matter in 2088 do not sit on the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#7FDBFF][i]People[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF][b]Fallen Companies[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The giants Los Vales outgrew, ate or buried. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832326][color=#7FDBFF][i]Companies[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF][b]Foreign Companies[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The giants of the world outside — and what they want from Los Vales. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832326][color=#7FDBFF][i]Companies[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832715][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Fragments[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — Pieces of machines that refused to die, living in the internet nobody can switch off. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF][i]Nets & Bodies[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]G[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832716][color=#7FDBFF][b]Gangs of 2088[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — Where the megacorps do not go, or do not want to go, the gangs do. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF][i]Groups & Gangs[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832717][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Golden Mafia[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — It lent a city its first money and never stopped collecting. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830615][color=#7FDBFF][i]Groups & Gangs[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2833650][color=#7FDBFF][b]The Great Mergers[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — How twenty corporations became ten — and who owns your life now. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832326][color=#7FDBFF][i]Companies[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832718][color=#7FDBFF][b]Growing Up in Los Vales[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — Signed at twelve, named after a brand, scored from birth. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF][i]Daily Life[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]H[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF][b]Hermosa[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The city that began as a bet on chaos and ended in a flash of light. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834884][color=#7FDBFF][i]Los Vales[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]K[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF][b]Kizuna Implants and the Converts[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — From one new eye to a body with no flesh left. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF][i]Nets & Bodies[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]L[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2833664][color=#7FDBFF][b]Los Vales[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The country: history, geography, divisions, government, economy, people and culture of the Free States. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834884][color=#7FDBFF][i]Los Vales[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832546][color=#7FDBFF][b]Lucía Ferraz[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — The reporter who followed the money until it followed her. [/color][color=white][i]([/i][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#7FDBFF][i]People[/i][/color][/url][color=white][i])[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]M[/b][/color][/size]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE WARS[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF][b]First Corporate War[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (2001–2006) — [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]BeDay[/color][/url][color=white] against [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Dinoco[/color][/url][color=white] over the desert oil: the first real war between two companies, with private armies and open battles. The world learned a new word: MegaCorp. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF][b]Second Corporate War[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (2016–2017) — [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Sphere[/color][/url][color=white], [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white] and BeDay against [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]ArmaTech[/color][/url][color=white] over the technology of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]NASC[/color][/url][color=white], fought street by street inside Los Vales. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF][b]Third Corporate War[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (2019–2022) — the silent war of ArmaTech hackers against WM. It ended with a stolen warhead exploding on the roof of WM's headquarters, and the end of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832548][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF][b]Reality War[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (2030) — [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] against Sphere and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Bubble[/color][/url][color=white]: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoactive Reality[/color][/url][color=white] against virtual reality. Won by Zyx after the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Horizon Blackout[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF][b]Droid War[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (2044) — the rebellion of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]Unplugged[/color][/url][color=white] in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white]. Eighteen months of street fighting, ended by a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]kill code[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832554][color=#7FDBFF][b]Reunification War[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (2049) — the invasion by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]New American Union[/color][/url][color=white]. The most destructive war in the country's history, held back by WM, ArmaTech and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white]'s robot armies. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832554][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832555][color=#7FDBFF][b]World War III[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (2067–2073) — fought over water and food between the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832727][color=#7FDBFF]Neo-Soviet bloc[/color][/url][color=white] and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832728][color=#7FDBFF]Pacific Union[/color][/url][color=white]. Los Vales stayed neutral and came out as the richest country in the world. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832555][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE BLOCS OF 2088[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]New American Union[/b][/color][color=white] — the United States rebuilt by the military after the coup of 2012. Hostile; no peace treaty since 2013. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[color=white][b]Pacific Union[/b][/color][color=white] — Japan and its allies, led by Nakama. Rival and trading partner.[/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832708][color=#7FDBFF][b]European Federation[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Drexler[/color][/url][color=white], [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Serene[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Thames & Crown[/color][/url][color=white]. Banned Psychoactive Reality in 2024.[/color]

[color=white][b]Neo-Soviet Bloc[/b][/color][color=white] — armed by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]RedStar[/color][/url][color=white]. Still owes Los Vales for World War III.[/color]

Partner since "[/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832733][color=#7FDBFF]Grain for Robots[/color][/url][color=white]" (2058).[/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832686][color=#7FDBFF][b]African Concord[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Sahel Sun[/color][/url][color=white] and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832686][color=#7FDBFF]Treaty of Lagos[/color][/url][color=white] (2075). Neutral and wary.[/color]

Rivals in the sky.[/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF][b]Hermosa Massacre[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (1993) — the gang massacre that killed [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF]Kobe Portenova[/color][/url][color=white] and sent thousands of refugees down [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69[/color][/url][color=white]. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[color=white][b]ADVIRUS[/b][/color][color=white] (2020) — the pandemic that stopped the building of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] and emptied the casinos of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Noites[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832736][color=#7FDBFF][b]Urban Monopolization[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (2030s–2040s) — the slow death of every small town, bought, demolished and resold by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Portenova Corp[/color][/url][color=white]. The reason a country so large has only seven cities. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832736][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[color=white][b]Rebirth Plan[/b][/color][color=white] (2050) — the rebuilding after the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832554][color=#7FDBFF]Reunification War[/color][/url][color=white], based on total economic freedom and financed mostly by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF][b]Total Connection[/b][/color][/url][color=white] (2073) — free doses of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoactive Reality[/color][/url][color=white] distributed as a "social benefit", and a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white] for every city. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]→ Full article[/color][/url]

[color=white][b]OmniCredits Strike[/b][/color][color=white] (2081) — two million [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]OmniMart[/color][/url][color=white] workers demanded to be paid in real money. The strike lasted three days.[/color]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF][b]Hermosa Real[/b][/color][/url][color=white] — the rumored plan of Kobe Portenova III to clean the crater, wake [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Universalia[/color][/url][color=white] and rebuild the true [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]
